teams.synopsis: Tough depth with a bye and an injury colliding - elite ceiling once complete, but Allen and Kincaid can't connect yet.
teams.blurb: Jallen // tough depth w/bye and injury. Elite ceiling when complete. <mark class="hl-player">Allen</mark> + <mark class="hl-player">Kincaid</mark> can't connect.

teams.synopsis: Injuries have hindered this team all season, with a couple of sub-1-point wins along the way.
teams.blurb: Oh He Likes Cooking! // Eagles are backs. Injuries have hindered team all season. Couple <1 point wins.

teams.synopsis: A huge ceiling unlocked with no real weaknesses while healthy - the Collins IR stint hurts badly.
teams.blurb: Set Pitts Free // huge ceiling unlocked. No weaknesses while healthy. <mark class="hl-player">Collins</mark> on IR hurts badly.

teams.synopsis: Kraft to the moon, and the WR room is nasty - running back injuries are the one thing holding this team back.
teams.blurb: Tony Fkn Romo // <mark class="hl-player">Kraft</mark> to the moon. Wide receiver room is nasty. Running back injuries holding the team back.

teams.synopsis: Consistent, with elite wide receivers and Lamar Jackson leading the way.
teams.blurb: The Minutemen // consistent. Elite wide receivers. <mark class="hl-player">Lamar Jackson</mark>.

teams.synopsis: A very good WR trio, finally healthy, but still hasn't shown a high ceiling.
teams.blurb: Rolls With Butter // very good wide receiver trio. Healthy. Hasn't shown high ceiling.

teams.synopsis: Could be 4-1 with just 6 more points total - scary depth once healthy, and active in the trade market.
teams.blurb: Silence of the Lambs // could be 4-1 if he scored 6 more points in total. Scary depth when complete. Actively great in the trade market.

teams.synopsis: A mid stretch over the past two weeks, with inconsistent WRs - the QB and RB production is still carrying the team.
teams.blurb: N.Y. Routensss // mid past 2 weeks. Wide receivers have been inconsistent. Good quarterback + running back production.

teams.synopsis: A massive Week 5, with Chase looking like the best WR in football lately - injuries are the only real threat.
teams.blurb: Glass of Charbonnet // massive Week 5. Injuries may hurt promise. <mark class="hl-player">Chase</mark> has been the best wide receiver in football as of late.

teams.synopsis: Consistently great Weeks 3-5, though RB byes and injuries cloud the Week 6 outlook - the WRs are outplaying expectations.
teams.blurb: Tee Time // consistently great Weeks 3-5. Running back byes and injuries hurt Week 6 outlook. Wide receivers outplaying expectation.

teams.synopsis: Achane and Pitts have both underperformed, with more injuries piling on.
teams.blurb: Station Grits // injuries (<mark class="hl-player">Anthony Richardson</mark>). <mark class="hl-player">Achane</mark> and <mark class="hl-player">Pitts</mark> have underperformed.

teams.synopsis: Another brutal Week 5 loss at 0-5, but the team doesn't look as feeble as the record suggests.
teams.blurb: Philly Special // brutal loss in Week 5. Team doesn't look as feeble. 0-5.

teams.synopsis: Ryan's injuries and inconsistent WRs are dragging on this team, LaPorta included.
teams.blurb: <mark class="hl-player">LaPorta</mark> potty // injuries. Jaguar's running backs. Inconsistent wide receivers.

teams.synopsis: A brutal Week 5 loss and a Tyreek-dependent offense have this team at 0-5 - Burrow and London are the exceptions.
teams.blurb: Legoon // brutal loss in Week 5. <mark class="hl-player">Tyreek</mark> has been mid, hence 0-5. <mark class="hl-player">Burrow</mark> and <mark class="hl-player">London</mark> popping.
